prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Screen Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a split card layout comparing preset companions and custom pet photo creation options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your New Desktop Pet", "body": "Select a ready-to-go companion or build a custom pet using your own photos."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Companion Greeting Screen: Insert a new interactive greeting screen in the finish step where users can click their pet before it lands on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_greeting", "home_intro"], "new_greeting": {"headline": "Say Hello to Your Companion", "body": "Click on your pet to see how it responds on your desktop screen.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [home, new_flow] Progressive Generation Status Flow: Add a live status preview with clear progress indicators on the waiting screen while pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "We are preparing your companion desktop graphics. This takes just a moment."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Companion Path Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout showcasing desktop pet interactive highlights before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion Awaits", "body": "Explore how your pet lives on your desktop alongside your daily work."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Warning: Add a helpful sign-in hint explaining that using the same account keeps existing pets saved across desktop sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your main account so your pet and progress stay saved across devices."}}
5: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification Option: Enable desktop notifications when pet generation completes while the app is in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Overlay Troubleshooting Note: Display a troubleshooting hint on home_intro explaining how to summon the pet if it does not show up on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Pet not showing on screen? Click the system tray icon or press Alt+P to summon your pet."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Upload Hint: Add photo lighting and angle guidance on the photo upload screen to prevent custom pet generation failures.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload bright, well-lit photos of your pet facing directly toward the camera."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Progress Step Indicator: Enable step counters and progress tracking on the choose_path screen to set clear time expectations.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Select Your Pet Setup Path", "body": "Pick a ready companion or create a custom pet in just a few quick steps."}}
9: [finish, incentive] Starter Pet Care Incentive Badge: Display a highlighted welcome badge detailing unlocked interactive companion features on the intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your companion is now active on your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Interactive Care Unlocked", "style": "playful"}]}}

Adding a new interactive greeting screen within the onboarding sequence is permitted under rule 4.
Valid waiting screen enhancement showing real generation progress and time estimate.
Valid redesign of the story screen that continues to introduce the companion pet.
Valid sign-in hint added within onboarding limits.
Valid notification option and hint added to the waiting screen as allowed by rule 4.
Valid troubleshooting hint added to home_intro screen within onboarding.
Valid photo quality guidance added to the upload_photos screen.
Valid progress indicators and copy update on choose_path screen preserving its core function.
Valid feature highlight badge on home_intro without violating pricing or fair design rules.
